internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Checkout Service Due to Payment Service Flag
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 11:43 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as an error injection in the payment service caused by the activation of the 'paymentFailure' flag. This flag caused all payment requests to fail, leading to a 100% error rate in the payment service and a corresponding high error rate in checkout. The flag was disabled at 12:03 UTC, resulting in immediate recovery and normalization of error rates. No other latency issues were confirmed as root causes. The incident was resolved promptly with minimal customer impact.

Timeline:
- 11:43 UTC: Alert received for high error rate in checkout.
- 12:02 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection.
- 12:03 UTC: 'paymentFailure' flag disabled after approval.
- 12:03 UTC: Recovery verified with error rates returning to normal.

Action items include reviewing flag deployment procedures to prevent similar incidents.
